enrichment method: To understand the molecular mechanism of FgPacC30 in repressing the expression of iron uptake-related genes, we tried to identify FgPacC30-interacting proteins in Fg by performing the affinity capture assay using FgPacC30-GFP as a bait.
labeling: To perform affinity capture-mass spectrometry analysis, the functional isoform FgPacC (FgPacC30) was tagged with GFP and transformed into the ΔFgPacC mutant.
